verdict.rationale: Codegen's docs extensively describe delegating coding tasks to a built-in AI agent that can analyze requirements, implement features, fix bugs, write tests, create PRs, and interact via chat, CLI, SDK, and API (codegen-docs-1, -16, -22, -24, -29). This is core to the product and well documented across multiple interfaces (web, Slack, CLI, SDK). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party corroboration beyond vendor docs, and clearer detail on the native in-app assistant UI versus integration-based delegation.
